headlineVerdict: Inflatable tanning pool lounger, Amazon US: the category moves 135,138 units a month and the tanning sub-segment 11,214, but at the segment leader's $26.99 the fulfilment fee, freight and referral fee consume $17.05 before a single unit of goods is paid for. That leaves a 36.8% margin ceiling with the goods costing nothing, and about 1.8% at the 1688 list price. Reaching a 35% margin needs a price of $44.89 against a thirteen-year segment high of $32.99. Verdict: no.
